title: Abstract Particle Art with Scoring System
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an advanced abstract particle art experience using Three.js with a scoring system. Load the GLTFLoader from a CDN.

## Scene Setup
- Black background scene with a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 20), looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0x404040, intensity 0.5) and a point light (0xffffff, intensity 1.5) at (10, 15, 10).
- Load 'BoxAnimated.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at the origin, scale it to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Play any animations found in the GLB using THREE.AnimationMixer. This box serves as the central 'art nucleus'.
- Create a particle system with exactly 500 particles (THREE.Points with BufferGeometry). Each particle has random position in a sphere of radius 15. Use a custom ShaderMaterial or PointsMaterial with color 0x00ffff, size 0.15, transparent, opacity 0.8.
- Create 5 'attractor orbs' as THREE.Mesh (SphereGeometry radius 0.3, MeshStandardMaterial with emissive colors). Place them at: (-6,0,0), (6,0,0), (0,6,0), (0,-6,0), (0,0,6). Colors: red, blue, green, yellow, magenta respectively.

## Particle Physics
- Each frame, particles are attracted toward the nearest attractor orb with force proportional to 1/distance². Clamp max force to 0.05. Particles also have a slight drift velocity (random, max 0.01 per axis per frame).
- Particles should wrap around: if any coordinate exceeds ±20, wrap to the opposite side.
- Track total 'kinetic energy' as sum of velocity magnitudes across all particles.

## Interaction
- **Mouse Click on Canvas**: Raycast to detect clicks on attractor orbs. Clicking an orb toggles it active/inactive. Active orbs glow (emissiveIntensity=2), inactive orbs dim (emissiveIntensity=0.1). All orbs start active.
- **Keyboard 'R'**: Reset all particles to random positions within radius 15, reset all velocities to zero, reset score to 0, set all attractors to active.
- **Keyboard 'P'**: Toggle pause/resume of the particle simulation and animation mixer.
- **Keyboard 'E'**: Trigger an 'explosion' - all particles get a radial velocity of 0.3 away from origin. Add 50 points to score.
- **Keyboard 'C'**: Cycle the particle color through: cyan(0x00ffff) -> magenta(0xff00ff) -> yellow(0xffff00) -> white(0xffffff) -> cyan. Track colorIndex (0-3).
- **Keyboard '1'-'5'**: Toggle individual attractor orbs 1-5 respectively (same as clicking them).

## Scoring System
- Score starts at 0.
- Every second, add points equal to the number of active attractors multiplied by 10.
- When an explosion is triggered (E key), add 50 bonus points.
- When all 5 attractors are deactivated simultaneously, add a one-time bonus of 200 points (only once per occurrence; re-activating and deactivating all again can earn it again).

## HUD / DOM Elements
- Create a HUD overlay div with id='hud' positioned top-left, white text on semi-transparent black background.
- Display: Score (id='scoreDisplay'), Active Attractors count (id='attractorCount'), Particle Color name (id='colorName'), Paused status (id='pauseStatus'), Kinetic Energy rounded to 2 decimals (id='energyDisplay').
- Add a button with id='resetBtn' that performs the same action as pressing 'R'.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - score: number (current score)
  - activeAttractors: number (count of active attractor orbs, 0-5)
  - particleCount: number (always 500)
  - paused: boolean
  - colorIndex: number (0=cyan, 1=magenta, 2=yellow, 3=white)
  - kineticEnergy: number (sum of all particle velocity magnitudes, >= 0)
  - explosionCount: number (total explosions triggered)
  - boxLoaded: boolean (true once GLB is loaded)
  - boxAnimationPlaying: boolean (true if mixer is active and not paused)
  - allDeactivatedBonus: number (total times the all-deactivated bonus was awarded)
  - attractorStates: array of 5 booleans (true=active for each orb)
  - particleColorHex: number (current color hex value)
  - frameCount: number (incremented each animation frame)
  - resetCount: number (how many times reset was triggered)
physics_constraints: Particles attracted to nearest active attractor with 1/r² force clamped at 0.05. Particle positions wrap at ±20. Kinetic energy must be non-negative and NaN-free. Drift velocity max 0.01 per axis per frame.
